children: Osprey Acquisition Corp. III reported net income for the quarter, driven by interest earned on cash and securities in its trust account, which more than offset general and administrative costs. The blank-check company said it has not begun operations or generated revenue and continues to identify a target for a business combination.
: Cash and securities held in trust totaled $302.7M at September 30, 2026.
: The company completed its initial public offering on July 2, raising $300.2M from 30.015M units, including full exercise of the over-allotment option.
: The company continued identifying a target for a business combination and said it may pursue a combination in any business or industry.
: At September 30, the company had $1.2M in cash and a working capital surplus of $1.2M.
